layers.process: Mueller Hut (Aoraki/Mount Cook National Park) must be booked from mid November to 30 April. All year, walkers register their intentions at the Aoraki/Mount Cook National Park Visitor Centre on the day they start and sign out afterwards; failing to do so may start a search. The route is an advanced alpine route with snow and ice possible from March to November. No dogs in the park.
